call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here and can hear you. Please go ahead and say something.

call.speech.bye.note: Review: adds "hav det godt" (take care) beyond English "Goodbye."; a normal pairing, acceptable.

call.speech.no_thanks.note: Fixed per back-translation note. Review: Adds a reason the English does not have: "det er ikke noget for mig" = "it's not for me". English is only "Oh, no, thank you." It should say just that, e.g. "Åh nej tak."

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I'll just have to think about that.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, before you hang up, I just have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Review: Written without the word for wait, so the no-wait list is not triggered. "inden du lægger på" = "before you hang up"; carries the hold-on meaning without the word for wait. OK.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "a moment", "wait a little", "wait a moment", "let me check", "I'll just look it up", "a second"
call.speech.no_wait.note: Review: covers a moment / wait / let me check / look it up / a second. English also has find out / have a look / verify; consider adding "vent", "jeg tjekker lige", "jeg kigger lige på det", "jeg finder ud af det". Du forms only, which matches the glossary.

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have called cannot be reached at the moment. Try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Oh, a package? Of course, just put it outside the door, thank you very much. / Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, we'll talk (to each other), we'll speak (to each other), we'll talk, see you, we'll talk tomorrow, we'll speak tomorrow, see you tomorrow, take care, so long for now, have a good weekend, good night, continued good day, bye bye, look after yourself. Wrap-ups: that's all, I have to hang up, I'll call later, I'm not keeping you, thanks for calling. Ends: Thank you very much for the help, goodbye. / Then we'll do that, we'll talk tomorrow. / Fine, then it's settled, take care. Not ends: Hi, this is Anna from the bank, we see each other rarely, but now it's about your account. / He left the meeting without saying goodbye to anyone, but tell me what you thought. / When we see each other on Thursday we'll sign, but let's take the terms here first.
call.speech.closing.note: Added the whole goodbye people actually say, with tomorrow in it: vi snakkes ved i morgen, vi tales ved i morgen, vi ses i morgen. The bare phrases stay. verified is false; a native speaker still needs to check the wording.

notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been handled

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; "{}" is still in your calendar. Delete it.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: Judged to be a sales call, so the appointment from the call was cancelled: {}

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: text messages can't be sent to this number, so call back yourself

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The number to be called back is not on the whitelist. Add it under Settings (or a prefix that ends with *), and then confirm again.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient's address doesn't look right

notify.g_short_password.back: Gmail's app password is too short. Enter it again under Settings (it is never shown).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: The AI answered and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: The AI could not establish a connection; the system hung up, and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: The AI failed; the call went to the answering machine

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: the decline message was played, and then the call was hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: number on the blacklist: the message that the number cannot be reached was played, and then the call was hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system judged it to be a sales / fraud call ({t}); dragging out the time is turned off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system first took it for a sales / fraud call; a second check found an ordinary call, and the AI went back to talking as normal

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system judged it to be a sales / fraud call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept the caller on the phone to make the person waste time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system judged it to be a sales / fraud call, so the AI deliberately kept the caller on the phone to make the person waste time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone rang the owner, but got no answer, and the AI told the caller that the owner will call back soon; the call was not treated as a sales or fraud call to be dragged out, so under "To-do" you write that a call back should be made as soon as possible

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone rang the owner, who picked up and was put through to the caller, and the AI left the call; the call was not treated as a sales or fraud call to be dragged out

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said it was urgent, and the owner was notified immediately; the call was not treated as a sales or fraud call to be dragged out, so under "To-do" you write that a call back should be made as soon as possible

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Declined while it was ringing: not answered, no AI

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played "{}" and hung up. The AI was not used.

notify.n_cw_headline.note: Fixed per back-translation note. Review: "Mistet" reads as "Lost"; English is "Missed". Understandable, but "Ubesvaret under et andet opkald" would be closer to the usual Danish phone wording.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read it, the notification channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI did not get a connection; the system hung up]

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the console

notify.s_no_service.back: No summary service is set up

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary – see the transcript in the console.)

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the console

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Would like to be called (the number has not been checked)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Would like to be called at this number (confirmed with 1, but the number is unknown)

notify.vm_decide_callback.back: Decide whether you want to call back

app.about_dedicated.back: In AI mode the module takes over the phone app, turns off the ringer and turns on Do Not Disturb, so a spare phone works best. If you want to use the phone as normal for a while, turn off the switch at the top.

app.about_legal.back: Laws about recording calls and about telling the caller that they are talking to an AI are different from place to place. It is your responsibility to comply with them.

app.about_rollback.back: If you want to remove Bageo completely, first turn off the switch at the top (back to an ordinary phone), then disable or remove the module in Magisk or KernelSU, and restart the phone.

app.agent_url_label.note: English says agent address; written as Bageo address, following the UI text rules.

app.check_priv_missing.back: Installed as an ordinary app (%1$s). Flash the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU, and restart. If you have also installed the APK file yourself, uninstall that copy.

app.check_priv_title.back: Installed as a privileged system app

app.check_privperm_desc.back: Given by the module at startup. They can't be given from this screen.

app.check_uplink_idle.back: Can't be seen right now. On some phones it only shows up during a call; the app notifies you if the audio can't be sent in.

app.check_uplink_missing.back: Requires the module: the MODIFY_PHONE_STATE permission is missing.

app.check_uplink_ok.back: The phone's audio output was found.

app.confirm_ai_body.back: This phone becomes an AI answering machine: calls no longer ring, and the AI takes them. Google's phone app is turned off, and Do Not Disturb is turned on.

app.confirm_normal_body.back: Calls ring, and you answer yourself. The AI no longer answers calls on this phone.

app.connection_hint_wifi.back: Wi-Fi: enter the address the computer program shows, for example ws://192.0.2.10:8787/ws?token=… The phone and the computer must be on the same network.

app.grant_perms.back: Allow the requested permissions, and then tap Start the service again.

app.header_compat.back: Tested on Pixel 7, 7a, 8 and 9. Other rooted phones may work; try at your own risk.

app.ip_code_hint.back: Get it on the System page in the console

app.ip_err_address.back: Enter Bageo's IP address, for example 192.168.1.20.

app.ip_err_busy.back: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute, and try again.

app.ip_err_code.back: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one in the console.

app.ip_err_unreachable.back: The address can't be reached. Make sure the phone and Bageo are on the same network.

app.ip_err_wifi_off.back: First turn on "Phones can also connect via Wi-Fi" in the console.

app.mode_err_busy.back: The previous switch is not finished yet.

app.mode_err_dialer.back: The default phone app could not be changed.

app.mode_err_dnd.back: Do Not Disturb could not be changed.

app.mode_err_dnd_mode.back: Do Not Disturb is still turned on. Open Settings → Modes on the phone, and turn off "%1$s".

app.mode_err_in_call.back: A call is in progress; hang up first.

app.mode_err_no_root.back: The Bageo module isn't running. Check in Magisk or KernelSU that the Bageo Uplink module is enabled, and then restart the phone.

app.mode_err_save.back: The mode could not be saved.

app.mode_err_screening.back: The call screening setting could not be changed.

app.mode_err_volume.back: The ringer volume could not be set.

app.mode_failed.back: The switch didn't finish. %1$s You can try again.

app.mode_switch_hint.back: Turn it off to use the phone as normal: calls ring, and you answer yourself.

app.msg_no_browser.back: No app on this phone can open web pages.

app.msg_perm_settings.back: Some permissions can no longer be requested here. Allow them on the app's page in the system settings.

app.msg_url_invalid.back: The address must start with ws:// or wss:// and contain a host.

app.msg_url_saved_pending.back: Saved. To use the new address, tap Stop the service and then Start the service when no call is in progress.

app.msg_url_saved_restarted.back: Saved. The service was restarted to use the new address.

app.msg_wifi_forgotten.back: The Wi-Fi connection is forgotten. Plug in the USB cable once to set it up again.

app.notification_text_armed.back: Ready. Waiting for calls; the phone stays silent.

app.notification_text_in_call.back: The AI is handling a call.

app.notification_text_normal.back: Ordinary phone: calls ring, and you answer yourself.

app.route_custom.back: Connected to the address you wrote.

app.st_ai_on_d.back: Incoming calls are answered by the AI. The phone stays silent.

app.st_normal.back: Ordinary phone: calls ring as normal

app.st_offline.back: Not connected to the computer yet

app.step_dialer_desc.back: So the phone doesn't show a call screen while the AI is talking.

app.step_module_missing.back: Flash the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU, and then restart the phone.

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English name, a nickname, etc. One per line, up to 10. Then the AI knows it is you they mean.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without promising anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key at Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI talks with. You rarely need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The voice sample plays three example sentences in the language chosen above.
console.f_voice_h.note: fixed: one name for the voice sample; compound fixed

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are picked up and hung up at once. If you want to let the phone ring as normal, use "Switch to normal phone" on the System page or in the phone's app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings a little before it answers, just like a human would. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Shortly before the limit the AI politely wraps up and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Make the AI ready while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks the moment it picks up the phone. Off: the caller waits 1 to 3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: calls without number display get the AI just like everyone else. Off: they hear a short message saying you cannot be reached, and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops and listens when the caller talks over it. Not all phones can do this; Bageo checks it by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller has finished speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: only the volume decides instead.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_h.back: A short message about right now, e.g. where a courier should put a parcel. The AI only mentions it when it fits the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Delivery: please put the parcel in the reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Lays a quiet room sound behind the AI's voice, so it sounds like a real person answering.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller obviously wants to sell something or is trying to commit fraud.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends to be interested and keeps asking about details to waste their time. It gives out nothing and does not agree to anything. Off: it says no thanks and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = same model as for normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI sound like you. Everything is optional.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in instruction is used

console.f_prompt_h.back: If filled in, it replaces the talk style and local habits. Each answer style saves its own; write {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answer style and name. Save first if you have just changed them.

console.p_replace_body.back: The editor already contains text. It will be replaced by the built-in instruction.

console.f_knowledge.back: Notes the AI may answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back:
e.g. Parcels: leave them at the front desk.
Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6.
console.f_knowledge_ph.note: fixed: two lines like the English

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts the people who call might ask about, one per line. The AI must not make up anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from the blacklist or a hidden number is declined. Manage the blacklist under "Contacts".

console.b_reason_ph.back: e.g. verification calls from the bank

console.b_help.back: End a number with * to decline all numbers that start the same way, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, leading zeros do not count).

console.reject_decline.back: Hang up while it rings (the call never gets through)

console.reject_announce.back: Pick it up, play "cannot be reached", and hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The message is spoken in the language chosen above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Get a message when a call comes in, and the summary when it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent to any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: No notification channels yet. Add one to get summaries of calls on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check calls, have the AI call someone and handle to-dos directly from this chat. Send /help to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group you must state who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private chat the field can be empty. Your user ID: ask @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First switch on "Receive commands from this chat" in a channel above.

console.rc_env.back: Receive commands in the Telegram chat set via environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat from TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS limits who may give commands.

console.rc_errands.back: AI errands per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI errands from chat. At most 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: Above this the chat gets no more replies for the rest of the minute.

console.mcp_desc.back: Lets AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT look up your calls and to-dos. Leave it switched off if you do not need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Only works when this is switched on and the token below is set. The address is the console's address plus /mcp.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this token in the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: May it ask the AI to make calls?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me in a chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: "Ask me first" requires a chat that receives commands.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that run on a website: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.n_test_ok.back: Sent. Check that it has arrived.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot shows yours; for a group the group's ID is used, and the bot is added to the group. Send the bot a message once so it is allowed to write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in a Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot's token plus channel ID; one of them is enough. If you want them as a private message, write your own ID instead of the channel ID. Chat commands: fill in the bot's token and channel ID, and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (also Mattermost) or fill in the bot token and channel ID; one of them is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then fill in bot token (xoxb-), app token (xapp-) and channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). First add the bot as a friend. LINE Notify closed in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess, and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. A token is only required for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, and then copy its token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the example URL. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get the API token. Your user key is on the Pushover overview.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose "Sign" under security, then paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, and then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan website.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), an access token for the sender account, and the ID of a room the account is a member of (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google account → Security → Two-step verification → App passwords). Not your ordinary password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which of its services get the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that receives a JSON POST with event, title, body and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's menu … → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the URL you get. The old Office 365 connectors have been phased out.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, and copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: switch it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic), and enter its email and API key as email:key. Recipient: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, your user name and an app password (Settings → Security) written as user:password, plus the conversation's token: the last part of the link to the conversation.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, and then copy the webhook URL. On your own network the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the recipient empty to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or an email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to that group; empty sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Easiest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website without a recipient. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: Create a token for this sender in the Chanify app and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login is also used as the sender. Use an app password if your provider offers it.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (found under Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the one shown in grey; with Docker, or to reach it from outside, you must write your own.

console.use_this_url.back: Use the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call the AI writes a short summary. Normally nothing needs to be set up here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: By default uses your Gemini key. Choose "Another service" to use a different one.

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a call fixes a date (a delivery, an appointment), an "add to calendar" link comes with the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When the caller wants to agree on a time, the AI does not say yes on the spot; it says it will check and get back. You then tap Accept or Decline under "To-do" on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you have decided, the phone that took the call sends the caller a text (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: a text to a mobile, an AI call-back to a landline number. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (abroad, toll-free numbers and the like) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with "thinking" in the name. Low answers fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging, and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone, and accept the message "Allow USB debugging?".

console.ph_offline.back: Offline: take the cable out, and plug it in again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection is ready, and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off.back: The USB helper is switched off

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network instead.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools, or specify ADB_BIN.

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add your key so the AI can speak.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI what the people who call call you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions under "About you" so the AI sounds more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected right now. See "Phones" on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a channel to get summaries of calls on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: Requires a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone re-established the connection during the call

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message reached the time limit

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller hung up while recording

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer about how to reply

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer when the contact detail was read back

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: Caller said the contact was wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked to be called back

console.ev_gemini_fail_to_voicemail.back: The AI failed, went to the voicemail

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: The AI sent no sound, went to the voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: AI sound could not be played, went to the voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: Came in during another call, declined as busy

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: Recording or voice menu: hung up

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This text cannot be sent again: the appointment has not been settled yet, or the text has already been sent.

console.err_no_calendar.back: This call has no calendar suggestion.

console.err_no_audio.back: This call has no recording of that kind.

console.err_open_failed.back: The recording could not be opened.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background sound is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The sound file for this background sound is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: The voice sample could not be made. Check the Gemini API key and try again.
console.err_preview_failed.note: fixed: one name for the voice sample

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: The settings could not be saved to the disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: The task could not be carried out.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not know this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: "{field}" must start with http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the token or the password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not know this address or this token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service answered with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo does not send to this address. Enter the address of your own notification service.

console.err_network_error.back: The service could not be reached.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the console at http://name.local. Only letters, numbers and hyphens. Empty = switched off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with the camera on your phone to open the console there.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code for the console's address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to your home screen. Next time you just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon to the right in the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some older Android phones) use:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch mode from here

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: Calls to this phone will no longer be answered by the AI. It rings like a normal phone, and someone has to pick it up themselves. You can always switch back.

console.ph_now_normal.back: It is now a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: switch when it is over

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in a call. Try again when it is over

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still busy with the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module is not running on the phone. Check in Magisk or KernelSU that Bageo Uplink is switched on, and then restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not switch its default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the setting for call filtering

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change Do Not Disturb

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not switch the ringtone on again

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the app on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed yet. Update the page in a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: something went wrong on the phone

console.er_new_d.back: The AI calls, sorts it out and tells you how it went. During the call you can read along and tell the AI what to do at any time.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to find a contact, or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No contact with that name. You can also type the number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact in the list, or type a phone number.

console.er_task.back: What needs to be sorted out

console.er_task_ph.back: e.g. Book a table for 4 tomorrow at 7 p.m. in the name of Jensen, non-smoker; if 7 p.m. is taken, 7:30 to 8 is also fine — or: Ask which day of the weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: Write what you want sorted out and what you can agree to. If the AI is in doubt during the call, it asks you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf as your assistant.

console.er_id_owner_d.back: The AI speaks as if it is you.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line that can call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (ordinary phone, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in normal phone mode cannot make AI calls. Switch it back so the AI answers, on the System page.
console.er_phone_h.note: fixed: mode label no longer spliced into the sentence

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so the AI does not have to stop and ask during the call.

console.er_started.back: Passed on to the AI. It is calling now.

console.er_queued.back: Put in the queue. The AI calls as soon as a phone is free.

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs to be sorted out. The AI calls, handles it and tells you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody picks up, or the line is busy, it rings again every minute, up to 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Ring again until answered: attempt {n} got no answer, rings again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Dialing, waiting for them to pick up…

console.er_watching.back: You are watching along: if the AI is in doubt, it asks you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI decides by itself

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell them that 8 p.m. is also fine

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI ends the call immediately. The errand may not be finished yet.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other party

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not there, no answer

console.er_options.back: Their options. Choose one, and the AI calls back with it:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply, and get the AI to call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI calls {who} again and replies with this.

console.er_delete_b.back: It is removed from this list. The call history is still saved.

console.er_err_no_number.back: Enter the number to be called.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: That number does not look right.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or premium-rate number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM card that can call numbers in this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not taken a call yet, so the system does not know which SIM cards it has. Call it once, and try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI should sort out.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: It is too long: at most 1,000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is ready right now (none connected, or all are set to ordinary phone).

console.er_err_not_found.back: That AI errand or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still in the queue or in progress. Try again when it is over.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI cannot pass the message on.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Who the AI says it is when it calls for you. Each AI errand can still choose its own.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: The whitelist (family and friends; can be put through to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: The stalling list (the AI drags out the time from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you, and when. This does not replace the emergency call centre.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: send on to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers and puts you through if it is urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone calls when something is urgent.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: When it is set, the console asks for it when it is opened (once per browser). Necessary for opening the console on your phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_title.back: Choose a password for the console (optional)

console.pw_setup_body.back: Choose a password if you want to open this console from outside your home network. You can change it later under Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. You are asked again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel you must state who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message the field can be empty. Your ID: turn on Developer Mode, right-click your name → Copy user ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel you must state who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a direct message the field can be empty. Your member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with others you must state who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. A room with only you and the bot can be empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check calls, get the AI to call someone and handle to-dos directly from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check calls, get the AI to call someone and handle to-dos directly from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" to see the commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent: could not get hold of you

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI left the call while it was calling you

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not place the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: It is too long. Make it shorter.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: That question has already been answered or has expired.

console.d_del_call_b.back: The summary, the transcript and the recording are deleted permanently.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All finished calls and their recordings are deleted permanently. Calls in progress are kept.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait until the call ends before you delete it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this offline phone from the list. Earlier calls are still saved.

console.err_device_online.back: First disconnect this phone before you delete it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the call on this phone is over.

console.bl_mode.back: When a number on the blacklist calls:

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choose the voice for the message

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only numbers on the blacklist may end with *, and there must be at least 3 digits before it (leading zeros do not count).

console.sms_empty_d.back: Texts that your phones receive appear here when the text forwarding is running.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation, or tap "New text".

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send texts right now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: You cannot reply to this sender.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: This phone's app is too old to send texts.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The phone's app does not have permission to send texts. Allow it on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send it.

console.sms_err_number.back: Check the number, and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The chosen SIM card is not in the phone.

console.f_keep_h.back: Calls and recordings, texts, AI errands and to-dos that are older than this are deleted automatically.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: Phones can also connect via Wi-Fi

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: On: a phone that has been connected with USB once keeps working over Wi-Fi when you take the cable out. Off: phones only connect via USB.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use this if a phone has gone missing, or someone else has used it.

console.f_wl_mode_h_direct.back: This phone does not answer; your telecom provider forwards the call to your number, and the AI is silent. First switch the phone to normal phone, and dial **67*your number# to turn on forwarding when busy, otherwise the call ends up at the answering machine.

console.f_wl_mode_h_emergency.back: The AI answers first; if it is urgent, it asks the caller to wait and calls you, and when you pick up, you talk directly with them. If you do not answer, the AI says that you will call back. Without your number you only get a notification.

console.wl_call_terms_1.back: The AI can make mistakes: it may not call you about something that is really urgent, or it may call you when it is not urgent.

console.wl_call_terms_2.back: This does not replace the emergency call centre. If a life is in danger, the caller must call the local emergency number directly.

console.wl_call_terms_3.back: The call to you is made from this phone's SIM card. Your telecom provider charges as usual; international or roaming calls may cost more.

console.wl_call_terms_4.back: When you have been put through, the call is recorded according to your settings. You are yourself responsible for complying with local law about informing people that the conversation is recorded.

console.wl_call_terms_5.back: The call to you may not get through. You use this at your own responsibility; Bageo and the developers are not liable for any loss.

console.f_wl_who_others.back: Numbers that are not in your contacts

console.f_wl_who_others_h.back: Includes hidden numbers. A stranger who says it is urgent may be fraud; only switch this on if you need it.

console.f_wl_who_h.back: Numbers on the blacklist or the stalling list are never forwarded.
